sourcePins.spanishReplay: 29 selected lexical records freshly matched to original Spanish gzip lines, including raw line newline hashes. Spanish pos labels may be adjective where English labels determiner; corroboration does not overwrite the retained English POS.

coverageBaseline.definition: At least one sourced English meaning or reviewed grammatical reading; not every meaning, usage or possible grammatical interpretation. No morphology-only fallback, untranslated lemma or placeholder counts.

productionPackagingRequirements.reason: Research Spanish corroboration objects contain full records, including third-party literary/example quotations and unrelated nonlexical material. Semantic approval does not authorize redistributing unselected quotations; production must retain only required lexical fields and raw source hashes through an explicitly bound sanitized derivative or proof projection.
productionPackagingRequirements.displayPolicy: Retain full reviewed contexts in audit; learner-facing context should explain grammar, not JSON form_of fields, previous FreeDict holds, coverage accounting or lemma-selection implementation.

guards: Exact per-analysis word/POS/raw hashes/sense indices/English/context only; no blind lemma replacement or other form/alias authority.
Runtime child grammar derives from the exact child: do not union masculine/singular lemma citation metadata onto feminine/plural forms. Preserve source metadata in audit.
Possessed noun/referent agreement does not identify owner sex or owner plurality; TUYOS selects one familiar addressee tú.
Preserve selected formal/literary/relative/obsolete sense labels. Do not import unrelated Mexico vocative, Spain construction, neuter pronoun or interrogative analyses.
Accented demonstrative source spellings remain distinct accepted lookup identities; no assertion of a modern accent mandate or accent folding.
Original3 MUCHO pronoun holds, ESTA FreeDict hold and all previous source-specific rejected analyses remain unchanged despite new independent determiner meanings.
Meanings are selected literal mappings, not full noun-phrase translations, examples, possible-answer changes or measured new coverage.
